Madrid (Madring) — circuit survey

Spanish GP · Spain · theme modern · day, dry-plain palette · base sha a24017f on cursor/madrid-survey-a1 (tooling merge #shared-shot-tooling-5b45 + lighting PR #1979 merged, both clean) · surveyed 2026-10-15 · read-only (no js/ or css/ edits).

Verdict. The geometry is sound (verify-track OK, audits within baselines) and the road matches the turn table. The biggest finding is placement: La Monumental's dressing and its 13.5° banking sit on turn 17 (s≈0.74), while the one unbanked 217° sweeper that fits the description is at s≈0.38–0.51. Weather response is correct for rain/storm and weak for overcast/fog (sky stays blue).

5 · Ranked defects and suggested fixes (not applied)

High · medium confidence

1. La Monumental banking, stands, aprons and floods are ~0.3 lap from the sweeper that matches it

Measured: the only 13.5° bank lift is at s0.734–0.766 (T17, 63° L, R≈53 m, 3.36 m lift); the 217°/440 m sweeper at s0.38–0.51 has no bank, no stands, no floods (frames 07, 08). Real Curve 12 is ~548 m, ~24 % banked; the sweeper is the only built corner of that size. Guess: the bowl belongs on the sweeper (T10–T11 in the turns table); the brief's "s≈0.70–0.85" appears to be the error carried into code.

Where: js/circuits/madrid.js:24 (bankZones {frac:0.75, 13.5°, 180 m}); scenery/madrid.js:577 (at(0.76)), :589–:606 (ring of stands, arcades 0.705+, flood masts 0.70–0.82), :629–:638 (aprons/fins 0.688–0.838), docs/tracks/madrid.md §4 (s0.75–0.80 rows).

Fix: anchor the bank by turn index ({turn:N}, js/track/CLAUDE.md) on the sweeper and widen to ~440 m; move the scenery fracs to the same span (the +18 m crest at s0.40 and 6–7 % grades make the site hilly, re-check aprons); update the brief. Confirm with a rendered lap and verify-track after.

Medium

2. Day overcast and fog do not touch the sky

Measured (mean RGB of the top 20 rows, centre): dry 18–27,82–88,191 · overcast 27–33,85–89,181–182 · fog 34–39,86–89,169–170 · rain 129,138,161 · storm 141,145,154. Overcast frames 28–33 look like clear days with slightly flat light; fog (34–39) only whitens the ground. Rain and storm respond correctly (the PR #1979 effect).

Where: engine/lighting, not Madrid: js/lighting/atmosphere.js (sky/horizon blend for overcast and fog). Fix: give overcast a grey zenith/horizon blend and fog a horizon-matching sky; check the other circuits before accepting, since this is shared.

Medium

3. Sierra de Guadarrama reads as flat grey slabs

Frames 03, 04, 07, 08: hard-edged trapezoid slabs with a clean flat top, same silhouette, in unnatural grey on the day sky; in fog the lower half fades but the top stays crisp. Where: scenery/madrid.js:1084–:1099 (ridge() six slots, width 540–800, depth 170, height 90–150). Fix: add a second offset layer and a taller/narrower profile with lower-contrast haze colour, or break the top edge.

Medium

4. Docs claim tunnels that are not modelled

docs/tracks/madrid.md:72 says "Already modelled: … both tunnel portals". No tunnel/portal code exists in js/circuits/madrid.js or the scenery file (only overpass decks, :651–:691), and the engine has no def tunnels key. Fix: correct the doc or add portal emitters at the two real tunnel sites (positions need a source; I have none).

Medium · engine, uncertain

5. Wet/rain/storm: mirrored ghosts on grass

Frames 17, 22–27, 46: translucent copies of trees and lamp bases mirrored under them on the terrain (planar reflection applied to non-road materials). Probably shared with other circuits; no Madrid-specific cause found.

Low

6. Road width is 14 m everywhere

baseHW: 7 (js/circuits/madrid.js:16), no width zones. The brief quotes 12 m, and 15 m on the main straight and T1. Add width zones if the source holds; a 2 m error is visible beside an F1 car.

Low

7. Night is unauthored

night:false; night frames (55–62) work from generic lamp pools. Monumental masts use pool:false (scenery/madrid.js:603) so they emit no light pool. Dusk frames (47–50) show a heavy orange wash on the plain. Not defects if Madrid stays a day race.

Low · uncertain

8. Grey slab at the pit straight

Frame 01 and the night/rain variants: a flat grey surface fills the lower-left of the orbit shot beside the pit lane with a visible seam. Could be the garage roof seen from the orbit camera; not confirmed with a second angle.

Night and lighting

night only recolours glass, tower glass, the beacon and a few seat caps (:21, :417, :424, :568). The Monumental masts use pool:false (:603, :607), so they add no light pools; the lighting exclusion s0.68–0.83 also removes generic lamps there. Night frames 55–62 therefore light the road from the generic post lamps only (visible pools in frame 58); halls and stands read through ambient.

Real-world cross-check

  • Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madring, fetched 2026-10-15): 5.414 km, 22 turns, "two tunnel sections running underneath an elevated motorway", banking limited to 13.5° (24 % gradient). It states no Monumental turn number, width, or main-straight length.
  • Source comments in the scenery file cite madring.com (Curve 12, 547.82 m, 24 %) and formula1.com; I did not re-fetch those. Turn 12 of 22 sits mid-lap, which supports the sweeper (T10–T11 in the turns table) over T17, but the curve numbering and the table indices are different numberings, so this stays an inference.
  • Tunnels exist in reality (Wikipedia) and are not in the game, so the doc line at docs/tracks/madrid.md:72 is wrong either way.
  • Width and main-straight length remain unchecked against a source (brief claims 12 m / 523 m).
